ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  3i Infotech has successfully settled historical income tax litigations totaling approximately ₹798.38 crores across multiple assessment years under the Direct Tax Vivad Se Vishwas Scheme. This resolution significantly reduces the company's long-standing tax uncertainty and litigation risk, representing a material positive impact. Crucially, the settlement requires no incremental cash outflow as the amount payable has been adjusted against accumulated brought forward losses, though the sheer scale of the prior disputed additions hints at historical financial challenges.
